from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation

from .rules import ROUNDING, scale


def to_minor_units(value, currency="USD"):
    """Amount -> integer minor units, staying in decimal all the way.

    Accepts the supported notation (thousands separators, "$", accounting
    negatives, surrounding blanks, sign and symbol in either order), rejects
    everything else with ValueError, and rounds the minor-unit value with the
    decimal ROUND_HALF_UP declared in rules.py -- away from zero for negatives.
    """
    text = str(value).strip()
    negative = text.startswith("(") and text.endswith(")")
    if negative:
        text = text[1:-1].strip()
    text = text.replace("$", "").replace(",", "").strip()
    try:
        amount = Decimal(text)
    except (ArithmeticError, InvalidOperation, TypeError, ValueError):
        raise ValueError(f"invalid amount: {value!r}") from None
    if not amount.is_finite():
        raise ValueError(f"invalid amount: {value!r}")
    units = (amount * scale(currency)).to_integral_value(rounding=ROUNDING)
    return -int(units) if negative else int(units)
